(Hauz Khas) Q: Is there parking at Hauz Khas? A: Hauz Khas Village has paid public parking at the village entrance, about a 3-minute walk away. We don't offer valet at Hauz Khas.
(Golf Course Road) Q: Is there parking at Golf Course Road? A: Golf Course Road has free valet parking from 12:00 PM to 11:00 PM.

(Golf Course Road) Q: Do you serve alcohol at Golf Course Road? A: Yes. Golf Course Road has a licensed bar serving beer, wine and cocktails. Guests must be of legal drinking age and may be asked for ID.
(Hauz Khas) Q: Do you serve alcohol at Hauz Khas? A: Hauz Khas is not licensed to serve alcohol, and outside alcohol isn't allowed.
Q: Are children welcome? A: Yes. High chairs are available, and the kitchen can make child-sized portions of dal, rice and naan on request.
Q: Can I bring my dog? A: Well-behaved dogs are welcome on the Golf Course Road terrace. Only assistance animals are allowed indoors at either branch.
Q: Is there a dress code? A: No formal dress code. Most guests dress smart casual.
(Hauz Khas) Q: Is Hauz Khas wheelchair accessible? A: The Hauz Khas dining room is on the first floor and reached by stairs only. For step-free dining, we recommend Golf Course Road.
(Golf Course Road) Q: Is Golf Course Road wheelchair accessible? A: Yes. Golf Course Road has a step-free entrance and an accessible washroom.
Q: Can you seat a large group? A: Online bookings are for 1 to 8 guests. For 9 or more, please call the branch and we'll arrange seating and a set menu.
Q: How do I change or cancel my booking? A: Please call the branch to change or cancel a booking. There is no cancellation fee.
Q: What if I'm running late? A: We hold your table for 15 minutes after the booking time. Call the branch if you'll be later than that.
Q: How long can we keep the table? A: Tables are booked for 90 minutes for 1 to 4 guests and 2 hours for 5 to 8 guests.
Q: Can I bring a cake? A: Yes, you can bring a celebration cake. There is a ₹300 cakeage charge per cake. Mention it in the booking note.
Q: Can you handle food allergies? A: Tell your server about any allergy. Our kitchen handles nuts, dairy, gluten and shellfish, so we can't guarantee any dish is free of traces.
Q: Do you have vegan options? A: Yes. Dishes marked vegan contain no dairy, egg or honey, and there are vegan choices in every section of the menu.
Q: Do you serve Jain food? A: Dishes marked Jain-available can be made without onion, garlic or root vegetables. Please ask your server when ordering.
Q: How can I pay? A: We accept cards, UPI and cash.
Q: Do you add a service charge? A: No service charge is added to the bill. Tipping is optional.
Q: Do you take walk-ins? A: Walk-ins are welcome when a table is free. We recommend booking for Friday and Saturday dinner.
Q: How far ahead can I book? A: You can book up to 30 days ahead, and at least 60 minutes before your arrival time.
Q: Do you have outdoor seating? A: Golf Course Road has a covered terrace; ask for it in the booking note and we'll try to seat you there. Hauz Khas has indoor seating only.
(Golf Course Road) Q: Do you have a private dining room? A: Golf Course Road has a private room for up to 16 guests. Please call the branch to arrange it.
Q: Do you have Wi-Fi? A: Yes, free Wi-Fi is available at both branches. Ask your server for the password.
Q: Do I need to pay a deposit to book? A: No. Bookings need no deposit and no card.
